ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 5 — Preventive Visit — Benny Leonard

code.originalText: Periodic adult preventive visit and recheck after the sick visit

text.paragraph: Periodic adult preventive visit, and the recheck after last week's sick visit. [S]

Mr. Leonard, 50, comes for his yearly preventive visit, which also serves as the recheck one week after the sick visit. He drank as advised, the lightheadedness went within a day, his urine is pale and the cramps have stopped. He has not taken losartan-hydrochlorothiazide for a week, and his home readings have risen to about 142/88 mmHg. He has not refereed this week. He takes atorvastatin each evening without muscle aches. He wants to be back in the ring next week, and asks whether there is a blood pressure medicine that will not dry him out in the heat. [S]

text.paragraph: Vital signs recorded on 2026-07-28; see the Vital Signs section. [S]

tr.td: Well; weight 73.6 kg, BMI 27.0; blood pressure 142/88 mmHg; pulse 72; no orthostatic fall
Fundi with mild arteriolar narrowing; no hemorrhages or exudates
Regular rhythm; fourth heart sound; no murmur; no carotid bruit; foot pulses normal; no edema

Breathlessness and tightness across the chest on exertion for about two months, late in long nights of refereeing in hot arenas, easing within a few minutes of rest; never at rest; no fainting, palpitations, orthopnea or ankle swelling; cause under evaluation with a cardiology consultation

S — Synthetic presenting problem anchored to his documented work as a referee; superseded at the consultation when stress testing showed no ischemia and the symptom was attributed to hypertensive heart disease.

Stage 2 hypertension found at a yearly fitness examination for his referee's license (164/100 and 160/98 mmHg), with left ventricular hypertrophy by voltage on the ECG; untreated; home readings to follow
S — Synthetic diagnosis at intake; reclassified as hypertensive heart disease after the echocardiogram at the consultation.

Hypertensive heart disease without heart failure: concentric left ventricular hypertrophy (septum 13 mm, mass index 118 g/m2) with normal ejection fraction, grade 1 diastolic dysfunction, a mildly enlarged left atrium and an exaggerated blood pressure rise on exercise; no features of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
S — Synthetic diagnosis made at the cardiology consultation; not a claim about his real heart.

Coronary atherosclerosis found by coronary calcium scoring (Agatston score 186, about the 80th percentile for his age and sex), without angina and with no inducible ischemia on exercise stress echocardiography
S — Synthetic diagnosis made at the cardiology consultation; not a retrospective diagnosis of the cause of his death, which is disputed.
Hypercholesterolemia: LDL 160 mg/dL, HDL 44 mg/dL, lipoprotein(a) not raised; no diabetes

Volume depletion after refereeing a long card in a heat wave while taking losartan 100 mg with hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg: lightheaded on standing, with an orthostatic fall in blood pressure, a prerenal rise in creatinine to 1.44 mg/dL and potassium 3.3 mmol/L; no fainting, chest pain or arrhythmia
S — Synthetic acute problem from the thiazide in summer heat; not a historical claim.

Volume depletion (E86.0). Resolved: creatinine 1.04 mg/dL and potassium 4.1 mmol/L, with no orthostatic fall. [S]
Keep drinking water between bouts on fight nights.

Hypertensive heart disease (I11.9). Off treatment for a week his blood pressure is back to 142/88 mmHg. A thiazide is a poor fit for a man who loses a great deal of salt and water in hot arenas, so he changes to losartan with amlodipine, the alternative Dr. Achebe-Lindqvist suggested, rather than restarting the combination. [S]
Losartan 100 mg and amlodipine 5 mg each morning from today; losartan-hydrochlorothiazide stopped.
Basic metabolic panel in four weeks, at the fifteen-week visit.
Written sick-day rules for his wallet: on a day of vomiting, diarrhea or heavy sweating without drinking, skip losartan and call.
Back to refereeing next week, with water between bouts.

Coronary atherosclerosis (calcium score 186) (I25.10). LDL 66 mg/dL, 59% below intake, on atorvastatin 40 mg without side effects: at goal. [S]
Continue atorvastatin 40 mg; lipid panel in a year.

Follow-up: Fifteen-week review in four weeks with a basic metabolic panel. FIT kit by mail. Screening results by phone. Second zoster dose in two to six months; influenza and COVID-19 vaccines in the autumn. Next preventive visit in one year. Next scheduled visit 2026-08-25: fifteen-week review: blood pressure after the change of medicine, kidney function and potassium, cholesterol on the statin, and the sick visit. [S]

Voluntary discussion of about 15 minutes, with his consent. He named a health care agent, recorded in the chart and not named here, and completed a health care proxy form. He said he would want resuscitation and full treatment for any illness from which he could recover, and asked that his religious traditions be respected in hospital. The plan will be revisited every few years or after any serious illness. [S]
